thesis: AZTA is a constructive pullback inside an intact uptrend: price sits above SMA20, SMA50 and SMA200 with strong relative strength, and has consolidated on light volume after the Nov 11 gap high. Fundamentals are improving, with revenue growth accelerating, GAAP net income just turned positive, and a net cash balance sheet that makes dilution unlikely. No earnings or offering event sits in the window, and the 19.6% short interest adds squeeze fuel if the tape turns. The setup is only moderate, though: the regime is risk-off, valuation is rich, ATR is high, and the first resistance at the 52-week high gives poor R/R, so the 2.7 R/R depends on the partial measured-move target. This is a small-size, stop-disciplined long at best, not a high-conviction one.
